title: Bevel button
description: A full-pill primary button (near-black on light, white on dark) with an icon before a semibold label and a thin inset top highlight. On hover it grows 2.5% with a long expo ease, picks up a soft inner glow, and a blurred sheen rises into its lower edge.
notes: two sizes: md (hero and closing call to action) and sm (inside the nav pill)
name: bevel-button

props.name: icon
props.description: an icon before the label (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: size
props.description: md: 44–46px tall, 18px label; sm: 38px tall, 16px label
